categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in textile manufacturing including nylon and polyester fabrics, tire cord fabrics, functional yarns, special protective fabrics, carbon fiber composite materials, packaging materials, and retail fuel station operations. It also engages in polymer product manufacturing, software and IT services, tourism and leisure facilities, and cultural event production. The fuel station segment includes retailing gasoline, diesel, lubricants, car wash services, and convenience store operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced textile technologies such as nanofiber electrospinning membranes for waterproof and breathable fabrics, AI and big data for production optimization, automated equipment, and sustainable materials including recycled ocean plastics and bio-based fibers. It has integrated production lines for weaving, dyeing, finishing, and composite material fabrication, and employs ISO-certified environmental and safety management systems. Carbon fiber composite production includes multi-axial weaving and resin impregnation with certifications like DNV.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global and international brand apparel manufacturers in sportswear, outdoor performance, casual fashion, and umbrella markets. Other customers include tire manufacturers, bicycle tire producers, industrial and protective clothing users, medical and cleanroom sectors, and packaging clients primarily in Japan and the Americas. The fuel stations serve retail consumers and corporate bulk fuel customers in Taiwan.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover Taiwan, Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand, Laos, Myanmar), South Asia (India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka), Northeast Asia (China, Hong Kong, Japan, Korea), the United States, Europe, and the Middle East. Manufacturing facilities are located in Taiwan, Vietnam, China, and Hong Kong. The fuel station business is concentrated in Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the textile and chemical supply chains, producing intermediate and finished textile products and composite materials. It sources raw materials such as polyamide and polyester yarns from upstream suppliers including affiliated petrochemical companies. The fuel station business operates at the downstream retail distribution end of the petroleum supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-value, differentiated, and sustainable textile products using recycled and bio-based materials, advancing AI-driven production optimization, and digital transformation of supply chains. R&D focuses on nanofiber membranes, eco-friendly functional fabrics, carbon fiber composites for diverse applications, and packaging materials compliant with environmental regulations. The company also emphasizes ESG integration, climate risk management, and expanding global market presence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of textiles, composite materials, packaging products, and petroleum products via fuel stations. The company also earns income from related services such as car wash and convenience store sales at fuel stations. Licensing or subscription models are not indicated; revenue is primarily transactional and B2B with some B2C in fuel retail.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from domestic and international textile and tire cord manufacturers, including low-cost producers from China and India. It maintains a competitive position through innovation, product differentiation, sustainability initiatives, and strategic partnerships with global brands. In the fuel retail sector, it competes with major players like CPC Corporation and other private chains, leveraging its affiliation with the Formosa Plastics Group for supply and brand strength.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$28.7 billion in the latest fiscal year, with a modest revenue growth of 0.75% and a significant increase in pre-tax profit by over 200%. It operates multiple manufacturing sites and over 100 fuel stations. The company has shown steady profitability improvements, ongoing capital investments, and a stable workforce of over 2,000 employees, indicating a mature but growth-oriented profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and sustainable textile products with advanced functionalities such as waterproof, breathable, and protective features. It differentiates through proprietary nanofiber technologies, use of recycled and bio-based materials, AI-enhanced manufacturing efficiency, and strong ESG commitments. Its integrated supply chain and strategic partnerships with global brands enable rapid response and reliable delivery, while its fuel stations offer comprehensive services and loyalty programs to enhance customer convenience and trust.
